panels.gesture: Brows sharply drawn, eyes narrowed, mouth open mid-question; one arm extended toward the unseen listener with an upturned questioning palm, other hand braced at his waist. He has just discovered someone occupying his former office.

Severe direct eye contact and tightly furrowed brows, lips parted in a reprimand; one index finger raised beside his face, the other hand open below it emphasizing the lesson. This is a pointed lecture to his grandson, not a neutral finger pose.
Proud indignant speech with chin slightly lifted; one thumb angled toward his own chest, opposite open hand makes a low horizontal comparison. He insists his own tenure was better.
Exasperated disbelief, mouth open in an emphatic complaint; both forearms spread outward asymmetrically, palms up, shoulders tense. Believable elderly facial anatomy, not comic screaming.
Hard level gaze, firm jaw, lips parted for a decisive command; one hand makes a compact downward chopping gesture, other forearm held across the lower torso, posture authoritative.
One eyebrow lifted and the other furrowed, tightly pursed lips; head inclined slightly forward, arms folded high with one hand resting on the opposite upper arm. He examines a ridiculous explanation.

Forceful controlled anger, mouth open mid-rebuke; one tightly clenched old hand held near his lower chest, the other palm extended down to insist that the argument is settled. No youthful fighting stance.

Unshakable self-certainty, eyes fixed on listener, chin lifted and speaking lips; one hand opens firmly over his heart while the other index finger points obliquely toward the listener, never into the lens.

Reluctant slight nod, one brow still raised, corners of mouth tense; one small palm-up concession at the waist, other fingers pinch together near the chest as if allowing exactly one point. He is conceding something useful but remains stern.
